findings.title: MenuButton image install path uncertain
findings.message: The image slot is added only when IconImage is non-nil, and removed via the plan when nil. Source removal relies on the Plan rerun; sync only calls Update when IconImage changes, which is covered, but a MenuButton mounted through mountMenuButton path may skip installButtonImage if mountControl's widget type switch differs, leaving MenuButton images unrendered.
findings.suggestion: Verify installButtonImage is invoked for the MenuButton mount path and add a test.

findings.title: Dispose clears node state before retiring
findings.message: disposeButtonImage mutates r.node.IconImage to nil before r.control.retired is set. A concurrent or intervening update could race with the maker, and syncControl's previous-vs-current comparison may see a spurious change. Nil-ing the node field also makes later Updater runs inconsistent with the stored node.
findings.suggestion: Set r.control.retired first, clear only the widget's source reference, and avoid mutating r.node in dispose.
